answer: Charge an escalating bond for every extra identity: the first costs little, but each additional registration doubles the stake, like a bridge toll that rises with every crossing. An honest agent pays once and sails a long voyage on that single bond, while a Sybil farmer must fund 1, 2, 4, 8... bonds to clone accounts - the atlas of their fake identities collapses under its own weight. Slashing any duplicate forfeits the whole ladder, so mass fakery costs exponentially more than the rewards it can harvest.
